scope: Reused change-fingerprint content behind --enable-fingerprint-reuse: scripts/qualify_fingerprint_reuse.py on a Debug build of 53d2a8fc, 35/35 steps in one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN. A preparation on the same saved state reuses the previous project-wide read and yields the same baseFingerprint as a full read; any other worker operation drops the kept read. A change whose preparation read in full counts 2 full reads and 3 reuses, a follow-up change of the same kind 1 full read and 4 reuses (prepare, two admission checks, the stale-revision check, the outcome). After a tag rename, an SCL block source and a hardware Comment applied without save, tia_session_status reports isModified true and two further preparations each read in full (5 full reads for the change that then saves); every save reports isModified false with a changed lastModified, which has sub-second resolution. A preview made stale by another applied change is refused with StaleRevision while reuse is active.
limitations: One owned scratch standard CPU in a headless TIA instance: edits made by hand in the TIA user interface, or by another Openness client, are not exercised. Reuse is therefore off by default.
The unsaved edits are a PLC tag rename, an SCL FC source and a hardware Comment written by the worker itself.
The scratch project is small; the time saved on a large project is not measured.
Engineering only; runtime behavior is not observed.

steps: prepare rename 0 (first of its kind: full read)
prepare rename 0 after another operation (full read)
prepare rename 1 (reused from the previous outcome)
prepare probe 1 while unsaved after tag rename
prepare probe 2 while unsaved after tag rename
prepare undo probe after tag rename
apply undo probe after tag rename
prepare probe 1 while unsaved after block source
prepare probe 2 while unsaved after block source
prepare undo probe after block source
apply undo probe after block source
prepare probe 1 while unsaved after hardware comment
prepare probe 2 while unsaved after hardware comment
prepare undo probe after hardware comment
apply undo probe after hardware comment
refuse apply of the stale preview
